0022600100.text: The Pelicans (0-1, 9th in the West) make their second game of the 2026-27 season on the road against the Utah Jazz (0-1, 12th in the West), with both teams looking for their first win. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain) and Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise), and Tony Bradley is day-to-day with a quadriceps strain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but New Orleans swept all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently winning 156-137 in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
